name: lineage-check-cost
goal: Validate shared inherited verification records once per check, preserving cycle, tampering and stale-evidence failures; prevent history growth from delaying or disconnecting normal source pushes.

evidence: The normal push integrity hook passed but took 728 seconds; SSH closed. Real lineage contains 21,324 dependency visits across eight records.
Frozen nine-case suite fails on original 6fc source: 482 validations for two shared records; eight other guards pass.
Memoize validated record objects within one call after recursion. Keep edge checks and reject cycles; never share cache across calls.
Added per-call object cache; inlined origin checks and filtered references. Source and complexity shrink; budgets unchanged.
Same frozen suite: repaired source nine passed; original one failed/eight passed. Actual 6fc integrity check passes in 11.19 seconds.
Isolated fixture reintroduces original source and fails; restored source passes. Frozen test SHA d6f24e943779; red/green receipt retained.
